title: Game and season prep
intro: Player views from the season models. Model predictions come from training games, out of fold. Descriptive tables come from training games. Held-out games feed none of them.
counts: {shown} of {total} players are shown. {hidden} are left out because no value clears its minimum sample.

rules.title: Minimum samples
rules.intervals: Every value shows its interval, or says it is a point estimate. Intervals come from resampling each player's own games.

list.title: Players
list.caption: Players with at least one view above its minimum sample

column.shot_making: Shot-making over expected, per hundred attempts

list.belowNote: Players below the minimum sample for this view come last.

player.hidden: Not shown. {n} {unit} is below the minimum of {min}.

shotMaking.value: Makes above expected, per hundred attempts
shotMaking.baselineError: Part of that value the baseline's own error explains, per hundred attempts
shotMaking.residual: Frozen model residual, per hundred attempts
shotMaking.ece: Calibration error of that baseline, out of fold
shotMaking.baselineErrorNote: Read this beside the value above. When the baseline under-predicts easy shots, a rim-heavy shot diet reads high.
shotMaking.residualNote: Given only for reference. The frozen model already knows the shooter, so this is not a measure over expected.

calibration.title: How well the baseline is calibrated
calibration.intro: Out of fold, by bin of predicted chance. Where observed and predicted differ, the baseline's own error moves a player's value.

rebounding.gap: The model expectation already uses his rate in other games, so the gap between the two is not a skill number.

absence.model: Model probability of missing the next tracked game
absence.observed: Observed share of games followed by an absence
absence.observedOnly: The model output was not stored, so only the observed share is shown.
absence.caution: Neither value is an injury forecast. Both count only whether he appears in the team's next tracked game.

similar.caption: Nearest players in the style embedding
similar.unavailable: The style embedding was not stored, so no similar players are shown.
similar.name: Player
similar.distanceNote: Distance in the style embedding. Smaller means more alike. Each distance is a point estimate.

player.descriptive: Descriptive: read from training games, not a model prediction.
player.hiddenCount: {hidden} of {total} players have no value above its minimum sample, so they have no page.
player.barNote: The line is the interval. The axis spans every shown player.

check.passed: Rebuilt output checked: {compared}. Largest difference {diff} {unit}, within the tolerance of {tolerance}.
check.failed: Rebuilt output failed its check: {compared}. Largest difference {diff} {unit}, above the tolerance of {tolerance}.
